race.comment: DUOMO (8) was back to his best last start when giving backers a bold sight, only to be nabbed on the line. Gets in nice and light with Newman's claim and should be at his top now. Should prove hard to reel in. DUKE OF CAMDEN (5) doesn't win out of turn but is knocking on the door. Continues to attract strong market support and now gets Thompson first time to pilot. Could make all the difference. SMOKE ON THE WATER (1) put two on the bounce before closing off strongly into third at Eagle Farm despite having difficulty getting clear. Rodd sticks fourth-up and can go a couple better with even luck. GALPIN (7) has been hitting the line nicely, so if they can utilise the low draw here he's right in the mix. But if they miss the start, she could be in a world of hurt.
